sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Serveman
Rathore, Advocate, for the .
petitioner.
Mr. Lokender Kutlehira, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent Today the petitioner is present and surrendered before this Court.
of Learned Additional Advocate General has placed on record a copy of the F.I.R.

Perusal of the rt F.I.R. shows that the name of the petitioner has not been mentioned in it, hence, considering this fact, the petitioner is ordered to be released on interim bail in F.I.R. No. 0014 of 2025, dated 07.02.2025, P.S. Sangrah, District Sirmour, registered for the commission of an offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC, 1860 subject to his furnishing personal bond in the sum of 25,000/-
with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer till further orders.
Petitioner is directed to join the investigation as and when directed to do so.
State is directed to file fresh status report on 16.04.2026.

(Rakesh Kainthla) Judge 06th April, 2026 (ravinder)
